answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the basalt log shows the live set and the juniper audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 422 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 83 aliases alive therefore means 83 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the cipher quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
